title: Our Planet
text:
We live on a big planet. The planet has many trees, rivers and animals. Trees make clean air for us to breathe. Animals need trees to live too.

Some people help nature. They pick up trash on the beach. They plant new trees in the park. We can help too. We can turn off the lights when we leave a room.

questions.text: What do trees make for us?
What do some people pick up on the beach?
Why are some people planting new trees in the park?
What kind of person turns off the lights when leaving a room?
options: A person who cares about the environment
A person who is always angry
A person who does not live here

vocabulary.definition: the large world on which we live
to take air into the body and send it out again
things that you throw away because you do not want them
living things that can move and are not plants

paragraph_translations: Vivemos em um planeta grande. O planeta tem muitas árvores, rios e animais. As árvores produzem ar limpo para nós respirarmos. Os animais também precisam das árvores para viver.
Algumas pessoas ajudam a natureza. Elas pegam lixo na praia. Elas plantam novas árvores no parque. Nós também podemos ajudar. Podemos apagar as luzes quando saímos de um cômodo.
